due_when.clears_when: A deliberately-failed diag relay run whose comment names the step that actually failed. ⚠️ Verify with BOTH controls: break the VM leg and break the post-processing leg, and check the comment distinguishes them. A single failure mode proves nothing -- the current message is 'right' for one of the two by accident.

origin.ref: E19 ops lane (session_0178qqSNhbW9vpQbREtc4drS), PR #12702, 2026-09-22. It read the failed job log rather than the workflow source, which is what surfaced this -- the manager's dispatch told it to, after the manager had itself published a wrong hypothesis from a workflow file the day before.
origin.rerun: Open the auto-comment on a failed vm-diag-snapshot run and compare its named cause against the job log's actual failing step.

routed_to: Small and bounded: the failure comment should distinguish WHERE the run died rather than assert a cause. The SSH/curl step succeeding is already observable in the job log, so the comment can say 'the VM round-trip completed; the failure is in post-processing' instead of pointing at secrets. ⚠️ Do NOT simply delete the secrets hint -- absent/mismatched secrets IS a real failure mode for this relay; the defect is asserting it without checking which step failed. Three states, not one: VM unreachable / VM reached and post-processing failed / could not determine.
what: vm-diag-snapshot.yml's failure comment confidently names the WRONG cause. On run 35649903349 it said 'The request parsed fine, so this is an infrastructure failure' and suggested VM_SSH_KEY / DIAG_READ_TOKEN unset or mismatched. MEASURED from the job log by the E19 lane: the SSH+curl round-trip to the VM SUCCEEDED (6 lines returned, no curl/ssh error), and the run died one step later in pure local Python -- ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'scripts', because the issues-triggered path never ran actions/checkout. No secret was ever involved.
why_it_matters: An error message that names a wrong cause with confidence is worse than a generic one: it sends the reader to the one class of fix a session CANNOT perform (originating a secret value is operator-only), so the honest response to it is to stop and ask a human. It cost a real measurement -- the E16 lane could not read prop_status_request's cadence state and had to INFER which ask-arm fired -- and the batched path had been broken since 2026-09-13 (a45d360 added the scripts.* import with no checkout), nine days, with nobody diagnosing it because the message looked authoritative.
